arena_modifiers.name: SWIFT CURRENT
arena_modifiers.canon: Movement infrastructure remains overdriven; every force inherits the same acceleration risk.

arena_modifiers.name: IRONCLAD
arena_modifiers.canon: The jurisdiction still issues protective matter to every recognized chassis, including the Vigil.

arena_modifiers.name: GOLD RUSH
arena_modifiers.canon: Local salvage law pays unusually high recovery bounties, attracting commanders and scavengers alike.

arena_modifiers.name: SCARCITY
arena_modifiers.canon: Embargo, depletion, or broken accounting reduces what confirmed kills can recover.

arena_modifiers.name: DEEP WAR
arena_modifiers.canon: The jurisdiction has already escalated before the commanders arrive; legacy threat assumptions begin one step higher.

arena_modifiers.name: THIN LINE
arena_modifiers.canon: Life support, evacuation capacity, or civil legitimacy is already critically depleted.

arena_modifiers.name: WAR CHEST
arena_modifiers.canon: Competing claimants arrive with pre-positioned reserves because the worlds strategic value was known in advance.

arena_modifiers.name: FRENZY
arena_modifiers.canon: Vigil scheduling has compressed its response intervals after repeated unauthorized access.
